移民健康附加费（IHS）原文：`£776 per year for studen: Immigration Health Surcharge, official wording: "£776 per year for students, their dependants, and those on a Youth Mobility Scheme visa, for example £1,552 for a 2-year visa". A Youth Mobility Scheme visa pays the same IHS rate as students; a 2-year visa therefore costs £1,552.
